title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 35: Josiah's great Passover and his death in battle against Neco king of Egypt.

questions.text: On which day did they kill the Passover in Josiah's time?
questions.explanation: Josiah kept a Passover to Yahweh in Jerusalem, and they killed it on the fourteenth day of the first month.

answers.text: The tenth day of the first month
The first day of the seventh month
The fourteenth day of the first month
The twentieth day of the third month

questions.text: Where did Josiah tell the Levites to put the holy ark?
questions.explanation: He said to the Levites, "Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built."

answers.text: In the house which Solomon built

questions.text: What did Josiah give the people from the king's substance for the Passover?
questions.explanation: Josiah gave lambs and young goats to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls, from the king's substance.

answers.text: Three thousand lambs and three hundred bulls
Thirty thousand lambs and young goats, and three thousand bulls
Ten thousand lambs and one thousand bulls
Seven thousand sheep and one thousand bulls

questions.explanation: They killed the Passover, the priests sprinkled the blood which they received of their hand, and the Levites skinned them.

questions.text: How did they cook the Passover according to the ordinance?
questions.explanation: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance.

answers.text: They dried it in the sun

questions.text: Why did the Levites prepare the Passover for the priests the sons of Aaron?
questions.explanation: The priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night, so the Levites prepared for them.

answers.text: The priests were busy offering burnt offerings until night
The priests had become unclean and could not eat it
The priests had gone home before the feast began
The priests refused to eat with the Levites

questions.text: Since the days of which prophet had no Passover like this been kept in Israel?
questions.explanation: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet.

questions.text: Where was Neco king of Egypt going when Josiah went out against him?
questions.explanation: Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

questions.text: What did Josiah do so that he could fight with Neco?
questions.explanation: Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him.
Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations.
